Habitat V0.6

Changelog

  • Added: Leap now has a separate customizable Dock from the native MacOS one. Have a second dock, or replace the original with features like widgets, smart stacks and App folders!
  • Added: A launchpad with multi view options and order customization! Replaces the native MacOS launchpad if toggled on.
  • Added: Folder customization! Burrow now features a way to customize and personalize folders across MacOS!
  • Added: IPhone Duo animation for the Macbook lid closing is now in Shadow Screen tools!
  • Added: Toggle in Squeak that makes the green stoplight button maximize windows instead of fullscreen.
  • Improved: Spark menubar icon stat graphs now update more efficiently.
  • Improved: Chomp Junk cleaner file search and removal.
  • Improved: Snap toolbar can now be dragged around.
  • Improved: Squeak minimize gesture no longer focuses the app minimized.
  • Improved: Notch Nook reworked with more tools and features from Habitat, system, & more.
  • Improved: Shadow Biscuits no longer write anywhere to help it redraw, now only updates when something changes.
  • Improved: Echo’s clipboard list and Spark’s energy list no longer look up each apps icon again on every redraw.
  • Improved: Echo’s clipboard can now be dragged around.
  • Improved: Language Localization for existing languages.
  • Fixed: Notch Nook not being correct height on built-in Macbook displays while other monitors were focused.
  • Fixed: Spark battery temperature graph sometimes reporting same temperature repeatedly instead of updating.
  • Fixed: Home page video carousel scrolling stutters.
  • Fixed: Mission control gesture being backwards sometimes.
  • Fixed: Snap auto scroll screenshot option sometimes failing.
  • Fixed: Squeak dock gestures activating on space around dock in blank space.


    • More to come.

    — Thank you for all the support & feedback!
